info.title: Mailjet Content API
info.description: A complete collection of all publicly available endpoints for the Mailjet Content API (v1). Manage email templates, template contents, images, labels and authentication tokens.

x-seo.title: Retrieve a single template
x-seo.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific email template using its unique template ID. This endpoint is particularly useful when you need to fetch…

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific email template using its unique template ID. This endpoint is particularly useful when you need to fetch the details of a single template for viewing, editing, or sending purposes. To obtain a valid `id`, first call `GET /v1/REST/templates` to list your templates.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent content of your template based on its status. This endpoint allows you to access specific versions of your template content based on their status — Draft, Published, or Autosave. To obtain a valid `id`, first call `GET /v1/REST/templates` to list your templates.

x-seo.title: Update template content
x-seo.description: Update draft template content. The endpoint takes the latest draft version, applies your changes, and creates a new draft version. If your template…

put.description: Update draft template content. The endpoint takes the latest draft version, applies your changes, and creates a new draft version. If your template content is published, you should create new content and then publish it instead. To obtain a valid `id`, first call `GET /v1/REST/templates` to list your templates.

Verify that your most recent draft is the content you wish to publish. To obtain a valid `id`, first call `GET /v1/REST/templates` to list your templates.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description:
Email templates are a crucial component for sending consistent and personalized
emails. These endpoints handle the creation, listing, retrieval, update and deletion
of email templates. A template includes metadata such as name, edit mode, purposes,
labels and publication status. Creating a template is the first step — content is
added separately via the Template Contents endpoints.

tags.name: Template Contents
tags.description:
Template Contents endpoints manage the actual content of email templates — the HTML,
MJML or plain text, along with headers like Subject and From. Content goes through
a lifecycle: Draft, Published and Autosave. Up to 5 versions per status are stored.
Use these endpoints to create, list, update, publish, lock and unlock template content.

tags.name: Images
tags.description:
Image endpoints allow you to upload images to the Mailjet image gallery, retrieve
their metadata and URLs, update metadata, upload thumbnails, and delete images.
Images can be categorized with labels and marked as favorites. The maximum upload
size is 2MB per image.

tags.name: Labels
tags.description:
Labels are used to categorize your images or templates by assigning tags to them.
Each label has a unique name, a color represented as a hexadecimal code, and a type
indicating whether it is used for images or templates (resources).

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description:
Token endpoints allow you to create, list and update Bearer Tokens for authenticating
Content API requests. Tokens carry specific permissions that control access to
resources such as templates, images and labels. Initial token creation requires
Basic Auth.
